text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - Polish foreign minister Dariusz Rosati begins an official two-day visit to Slovakia on Tuesday. He will meet his Slovak counterpart Pavol Hamzik, Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar and Parliamentary Chairman Ivan Gasparovic.
- Speaker of the British House of Commons, Betty Boothroyd, will address a session of parliament today.
- The international banking fair Finex starts today, with the participation of 291 domestic and foreign financial insitutions.
PRAVDA - Slovakia's largest cellulose and paper producer SCP a.s. said it planned an ambitious modernisation programme, totalling some six billion crowns, over the next ten years.
PRACA - Trade unions of Slovakia's engineering industry, the largest Slovak trade organisation, said it was concerned over the latest political and social development in Slovakia.

SME - Some 106,871 orders to sell privatisation bonds were registered on the o-t-c bourse RMS, since the August 5. Only 50 bonds were sold in anonymous trades - all for the minimum guaranteed price of 7,500 crowns.

-The Director of the official Slovak Radio (SRo), Jan Tuzinsky, has rejected a decision by the state radio broadcasting council banning the broadcasting of SRo's German language commercial station CD International, broadcasted mainly to Austria.
